title: The Burned Field
text: A crater, shallow and wide, its soil fused to green glass. In the middle lies a hull, broken open from above. Its frame uses our joint pattern and our bolt spacing. Whatever hit it came straight down, once, very hard. The glass is old: older than the oldest trees in the vale.

lines.text: "Straight down? From what? There's nothing up there but the moon."

choices.label: Scan the hull
choices.reply: Our alloy, to four decimal places. Archive: "No match on file."

choices.label: Mark it and go
choices.reply: Logged: one hull, burned from above.
